series.name: Richard Moody's Holiday Charity Party
series.tagline: A December tradition in Minneapolis: bring a gift, give back, celebrate the season.
story: Every December, Richard Moody's Holiday Charity Party brings friends, neighbors, models, business partners and supporters together to raise gifts and donations for Twin Cities children, teens and families.

Beneficiaries change with the year: the Domestic Abuse Project, Sabathani Community Center and The Link in 2010; WE WIN Institute and The Sanneh Foundation in 2021; The Sanneh Foundation again in 2023; and Sabathani Community Center in 2024, with a teen-focused gift drive and live music from Dave Thompson & Friends, DJ Cousin Christopher and a surprise performance by Esera Tuaolo.
In 2020 the party became a drive-thru toy and food donation event so the giving could continue.

facts.label: moved to a drive-thru donation event
all donations go to the featured charity

series.name: All Black Attire Fashion Show & Party
series.tagline: An all-black dress code, a 150-foot red carpet and an alley turned runway in Minneapolis's North Loop.
story: Presented with luxury boutique MartinPatrick3, the All Black Attire Fashion Show & Party turns the string-lit alley between MartinPatrick3 and the Hewing Hotel into a runway. Guests arrive dressed in black from head to toe and become part of the show.
A professional cast of models, stylists, musicians and performers presents the boutique's fall collections. The event has grown to roughly 400 guests.

For 2026 the evening partners with Coated in Love and its 3,000 Acts of Kindness campaign: guests are invited to bring a coat, gloves or other winter essentials for neighbors experiencing homelessness.

series.name: The Dandies Project
series.tagline: Celebrating the positive impact of men of color, with a sense of purpose and a sense of style.
story: IAmMoody started The Dandies Project to highlight the impact men of color have made in their communities, doing it with purpose and with style.
The project began with a photo shoot in December 2013 for a tabletop book, followed by a book launch at Coup d'état Uptown, annual lookbooks, video and press coverage.
In 2017 the project kicked off with a February event at Urban Eatery, including a silent auction, and a March lookbook release party at 514 Studio.

caseStudies.title: All Black Attire Fashion Show & Party
caseStudies.summary: A luxury boutique's fall runway in a string-lit alley: nine years running, about 400 guests, and in 2026 a winter-coat drive with Coated in Love.

sections.p: Give a luxury men's and women's boutique a fall runway moment that guests would dress up for, and give the evening a purpose beyond the show.

An outdoor runway in the alley between MartinPatrick3 and the Hewing Hotel, a 150-foot red carpet, a professional cast of models, stylists, musicians and performers, and an all-black dress code that turns every guest into part of the visual identity.

Now in its ninth year, the event draws roughly 400 guests, and the 2026 fashion-show tickets sold out. This year's charity partner, Coated in Love, collected coats, gloves and winter essentials for people experiencing homelessness.

caseStudies.title: Richard Moody's Holiday Charity Party
caseStudies.summary: More than three decades of December giving: toys, gifts and donations for Twin Cities kids and teens.

sections.p: Turn a holiday party into a reliable engine for giving, with a different local charity supported each year.

A full evening of live music, DJ sets, gift collection and guest hospitality, with sponsors and a named beneficiary each year. In 2024 the event supported the Sabathani Community Center with a gift drive aimed at teens.
Every dollar and gift collected goes to the featured charity. Past beneficiaries include the Domestic Abuse Project, Sabathani Community Center, The Link, WE WIN Institute and The Sanneh Foundation.

caseStudies.title: Threads of Impact: Black Fashion Week
caseStudies.summary: A fashion and beauty showcase celebrating Twin Cities Black designers, retailers and beauty innovators, curated and produced by Richard Moody.

sections.p: Curate a fashion-and-beauty afternoon for Black Fashion Week that spotlights local Black designers, boutiques and beauty artists.

A live runway with three designers (Kathryn Rogers of House of KLynn, Satiya Amporful of Uniquely Global and Marques Armstrong of Renaissance), a beauty showcase, vendors, refreshments, games and a "Chic Impact" best-dressed contest.
Minnesota's top models took the runway, and Sister Spokesman honored Richard and fellow fashion icon Sara Rogers for their contributions to the industry.

caseStudies.title: House of KLynn Runway Shows
caseStudies.summary: From the label's debut at Glasshouse to couture galas and an All White Attire Party for its bridal line.

sections.p: Introduce a new Minneapolis couture label and build a run of shows that grew its audience.

The House of KLynn introduction at Glasshouse, inspired by André Leon Talley; the spring 2022 runway as part of Black Market MPLS; the 2022 gala couture runway; and the 2024 All White Attire Party featuring the label's bridal line.
House of KLynn presents A Pop of Pink on June 19, 2026, a couture runway benefiting the American Cancer Society.

caseStudies.title: The Dandies Project
caseStudies.summary: An original project honoring men of color: a tabletop book, lookbooks, video and release parties.

sections.p: Highlight the positive impact of men of color in their own communities, with a sense of purpose and a sense of style.

A photo shoot and tabletop book, a book launch at Coup d'état Uptown, yearly lookbooks and video, and launch events with silent auctions, including the 2017 kickoff at Urban Eatery and lookbook release at 514 Studio.
The project was featured by Mshale and KFAI, among other press.

caseStudies.title: Minnesota 4-H Style Revue
caseStudies.summary: Three decades of volunteer coaching and production for the State Fair's youth runway show.

sections.p: Richard has volunteered with the 4-H Style Revue at the Minnesota State Fair for 33 years as of 2022, by his own estimate working with at least 700 participants.
Poise, personality and the freedom to embrace individuality: helping young people present themselves and their clothing with confidence.
The University of Minnesota Extension profiled the work in September 2022.

milestones: Began modeling while attending the University of Minnesota, including shows for Dayton's, Donaldson's and Powers'.
Produced and choreographed fashion shows in Paris and London.
Global brand ambassador for airforce Nutrisoda, attending events including the Grammys, the Oscars and the Aspen Food & Wine Festival.
Honoree at the 10th Annual Dress for Success gala in New York City (April 2007).
Volunteer producer and coach for the Minnesota 4-H Style Revue at the State Fair.
Curator and producer of Threads of Impact for Black Fashion Week (2025), honored by Sister Spokesman.

faq.a: No, but if you need one we are happy to give referrals.

faq.q: Are you a talent or modeling agency?
faq.a: No, but if you need one we can refer that too.
IAmMoody is headquartered in Minneapolis and serves the Twin Cities metro area, but we can handle your event anywhere in the United States, or globally.

faq.q: Can you sell my fashion for me?
faq.a: Sorry, no. We are not a retailer.
Absolutely not. Fashion is our specialty, but we can handle nearly any event.

faq.q: Why aren't there prices on the website?
faq.a: Every event is unique, so pricing is different from event to event. Send us the details and we'll send you a quote.

faq.q: Where can I learn more about Richard Moody?

faq.a: We are always interested in hearing from people who want to work with us. Email {email} or use the form on this page.
